person.label: Waiting for your confirmation
person.say: A terminal asks to say to {{session}}, as your words, {{level}}:
person.noSession: {{id}}: Daoris has no session by this id
person.attach: and to attach these files, read from this machine:
person.asker.unknown: Daoris could not name what sent it.
person.asker.help: Ask Daoris asks for this, with the key Daoris handed its conversation.
person.asker.session: Session {{session}} asks for this, with the key Daoris handed it.
person.restored: The record says it was sent by {{process}}, process {{pid}}, before Daoris restarted.
person.restoredPid: The record says it was sent by process {{pid}} before Daoris restarted.
person.restoredUnknown: The record does not say what sent it before Daoris restarted.
person.keyed: This carries a key, so it does not wait across a restart of Daoris.
person.hold: Confirm also lets this terminal speak for you in this conversation until it lets go.
person.view.repository-move: Moves {{repository}} from workspace {{from}} to workspace {{to}}: one row of this machine's registry changes, and no file is touched.
person.view.repository-move-starts: Moves {{repository}} from workspace {{from}} to workspace {{to}}: one row of this machine's registry changes, and no file is touched. No repository is in {{to}} yet, so the move starts it here.
person.view.session-archive: Archives these sessions on this machine: {{sessions}}. Each leaves Sessions' list with its record whole, and Show archived brings it back.
person.view.session-unarchive: Unarchives these sessions on this machine: {{sessions}}. Each is back in Sessions' list, in the group its state puts it in.
person.view.session-delete: Deletes session {{session}}: its record goes, with what this machine kept of it (its words, its transcript and its files), and nothing brings it back.
person.view.quest-delete: Deletes quest {{quest}}: it goes from every list, and nothing brings it back.
person.view.ask-delete: Deletes ask {{ask}} with every quest it became, or refuses whole if one of them has been started on: it goes from every list, and nothing brings it back.
person.view.work-pause: Pauses the work of {{scope}} {{id}} on this machine: what of it runs now stops as your own stop (sessions running: {{stops}}), and nothing of it starts until you resume it.
person.view.work-pause-already: The work of {{scope}} {{id}} is paused on this machine already, and nothing of it runs now, so this changes nothing.
person.view.work-pause-nothing: Nothing of {{scope}} {{id}} is open or taken on this machine, so there is nothing to pause and this changes nothing.
person.view.account-settings: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s model to {{model}} and its effort to {{effort}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.account-settings-model: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s model to {{model}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.account-settings-effort: Sets {{agent}} account {{account}}'s effort to {{effort}}, in the tool's own settings file for that account; an empty value returns it to the tool's own default.
person.view.work-resume: Resumes the work of {{scope}} {{id}} on this machine: its pause is lifted and the stops it made are released, and the driver plans its work again.
person.view.work-resume-nothing: The work of {{scope}} {{id}} is not paused on this machine, so this changes nothing.
person.cannotTell: Daoris cannot tell whether you ran this or an agent did. Confirm only what you ran.
person.gone: This no longer waits: it was answered in another window, or its terminal took it back.
person.notWaitedOn: No terminal waits on this now; it can read how it ended later.
person.unread: Daoris could not read what this rests on just now; it still waits.
person.draining: Daoris is about to restart; this still waits.
person.drainNothing: Waiting for the work running now to finish, since {{time}}.
person.drainDoor: Install later holds the update for this build; in a terminal, daoris update --cancel does the same.
person.unrecorded: Daoris could not keep your answer just now; nothing was done, and it still waits.
person.changed.session: Not done: the session moved on while this waited (it was {{then}}, it is {{now}}).
person.changed.turn: Not done: the session ran another turn while this waited.
person.changed.setting: Not done: what this would set changed while this waited ({{act}}).
person.changed.repository: Not done: the repository {{repository}} is no longer registered on this machine as it was.
person.changed.quest: Not done: the quest moved on while this waited (it was {{then}}, it is {{now}}).
person.changed.ask: Not done: the ask was closed while this waited.
person.changed.plan: Not done: what this would act on changed while this waited. Look at it again and ask again.
person.changed.branch: Not done: the branch {{branch}} gained or lost commits while this waited.
person.changed.wait: Not done: what this answers no longer waits.
person.adopted: Daoris is using a service it did not start, so your own acts (a review, a yes, an answer) are refused there. Close what started it and restart Daoris.
